outcome: Needle electromyography of the external anal and urethral sphincters
Neuropathic affection (external anal sphincter, external urethral sphincter, pudendal neuropathy)
cohort: The study included 38 females diagnosed with idiopathic overactive bladder and 22 healthy matched female volunteers.
finding: Pudendal neuropathy was identified as a significant attributing factor in the pathogenesis of idiopathic overactive bladder.
